title: Sexual Maturation in β-Thalassemia Major Patients in Assiut University Hospital
brief_summary: cross sectional study to asses sexual maturation in β-Thalassemia Major patients receiving Iron Chelation Therapy in assuit University Hospital and maintenance of 2ry sexual characters and reproduction
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* β-thalassemic Patients aged 10 years and older
* β-thalassemic patients receiving regular blood transfusions
* All patients are on chelation therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* β-thalassemic patients with major system complications as cardiac ,renal or hepatic.
* Patients not receiving chelation therapy
* Patients with other hemolytic anemia
study_population: β-thalassemic Patients aged 10 years and older patients receiving regular blood transfusions in Assiut Univ Hospitals and have chelation therapy.
condition: β-Thalassemia Major Patients Receiving Chelation Therapy
